facts: Triphenyl phosphate (TPHP), study C11042, male Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–881 mg/kg (6 groups, 20 animals). NTP Research Report 8, the first report in the series. GEO GSE121134.
Package layout: one 'Benchmark Dose Analysis' section mixing apical and genomic files, plus 'Summary Tables' numbered Table 1–6 (not NTP I04/PA41 codes); Table 6 is a Top-20 GO BP table.

Genomics: Affymetrix Rat 230 2.0 microarray (GPL1355, 31,099 probe sets), 20 CEL files, Partek batch correction. BMDExpress 2.20.0148 run 2018-04-12: Williams p<0.05 with 100 permutations, no MTC, fold ≥1.5 → 8 models lowest AIC, BMR factor 1 → GO BP (plain + deduplicated) and individual-gene categories (p≥0.1, BMDU/BMDL≤40). bm2 and JSON agree. Exports include individual PROBE-SET BMDs.

Apical: modified BMDS v2.7.0, already with high-dose dropping (refits with 0–3 top doses removed); Model Parameters workbook (single sheet, 22 datasets × models), fit reports (2017-12 .doc appendix and 2018-07 docx). No BMDS code package or ReadMe yet.
2-Ethylhexyl diphenyl phosphate (EHDP), study C10674, male Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–978.5 mg/kg (6 groups).

Genomics: Affymetrix Rat Genome 230 2.0 microarray (GPL1355), 31,099 probe sets, raw CEL files, RMA normalisation with Partek hybridisation-batch removal (before/after PCA images + Partek settings screenshot).

Published analysis (exported results text + JSON): BMDExpress 2.30.0507 run 2021-11-04 on 19 animals — Williams trend p<0.05 (10,000 permutations, no MTC), fold filter 1.5 → BMD with 8 models (Hill, Power, Linear, Poly2, Exp2–5), lowest AIC, BMR 1 SD → GO BP (deduplicated) and individual-gene defined-category analysis (p≥0.1, BMDU/BMDL≤40).

Apical: modified EPA BMDS v2.7.0 (python bmds 0.11 code package, 16 model-selection rules, Model_Parameters workbook = every model fit, model-fit report docx). Body weight, organ weight, clinical chemistry, hormones.
Extras: Gene description CSV, GO BP description TSV, PCA files, animal/CEL-file metadata, sample list with processing batches.
issues: The .bm2 and the JSON are DIFFERENT analyses: the .bm2 is BMDExpress 2.20.0151 from 2018-05-01 with 21 animals and only 100 Williams permutations (no fold-change NOTEL test); the JSON and all exported result files are the 2021 re-run on 19 animals. A consumer ingesting the .bm2 gets a superseded analysis.

facts: tert-Butylphenyl diphenyl phosphate (BPDP), study C10978, male Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–1032.5 mg/kg (6 groups).

Same platform and methods as NIEHS-02: Affymetrix GPL1355 microarray, BMDExpress 2.30.0507 run 2021-11-04 on 19 animals, Williams (10,000 perm) + fold 1.5 → 8-model lowest-AIC BMD (1 SD) → GO BP + gene-level categories. Apical: modified BMDS 2.7.
issues: The file named 'BMDExpress Project File (JSON format)' is not JSON — it is a second copy of the Java-serialised .bm2 (same 2021 analysis). There is no JSON export in this package.

facts: Isodecyl diphenyl phosphate (IDDP), study C20299, male Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–1054.2 mg/kg (6 groups).

Affymetrix GPL1355 microarray. Unlike 02/03, the published analysis is the ORIGINAL 2018 one: BMDExpress 2.20.0151 run 2018-05-01 on 20 animals, Williams with only 100 permutations + fold 1.5 → 8-model lowest-AIC BMD → GO BP (plain and deduplicated) + gene-level categories. bm2, JSON and exported text all agree. Apical: modified BMDS 2.7.
Isopropylated phenol phosphate (IPP), study C10866B, male Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–611 mg/kg (5 groups).
Same as NIEHS-04: BMDExpress 2.20.0151 run 2018-05-02 on 17 animals, Williams 100 permutations + fold 1.5, 8-model lowest-AIC BMD. bm2/JSON/text consistent. Apical: modified BMDS 2.7.
issues: 'BMDs code package' is published as BMDs_code_package.docx but is actually a zip (the python bmds package); 'Model Parameters' is published as Model_Parameters.docx but is actually an Excel workbook. Both open only after renaming.

facts: Tricresyl phosphate (TCP), study C10277, male Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–994.6 mg/kg (6 groups).
Same as NIEHS-04/05: BMDExpress 2.20.0151 run 2018-05-01 on 20 animals, Williams 100 permutations + fold 1.5, 8-model lowest-AIC BMD. bm2/JSON/text consistent. Apical: modified BMDS 2.7.
6:1 Fluorotelomer alcohol (6:1 FTOH), study C20027-01, male and female Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–1000 mg/kg (9–10 groups), liver + kidney. GEO GSE183705 (shared by the four PFAS reports).
Genomics platform switches to TempO-Seq S1500+ rat (BioSpyder), 2,654 probes, normalised log2 counts (RPM + 1, log2). Expression files BMDExpress 2.30.0485 (2020-11-18).

The BMDExpress project is ONE shared PFAS project (byte-identical across NIEHS-07, -08, -09 and -10): 16 experiments = 4 chemicals × liver/kidney × sex, BMDExpress 2.30.0507 run 2021-02-12. Williams p<0.05 (10,000 perm, no MTC) + fold 1.5 → 8-model lowest-AIC BMD, BMR 1 SD → GENE (p≥0.1, ratio≤40, fold change≥2) and GO BP (deduplicated) categories.

Apical: modified BMDS v2.7.0, with high-dose dropping up to 5 doses (each endpoint refit with top doses removed; the recommended fit may come from a dropped-dose run). Adds hematology and tissue concentration (PA43, PA48). Per-sex Parameter workbooks and model-fit appendices dated 2021-07-28.
QC: TempO-Seq sample sheet and per-sample QC with removal reasons (kidney 'overflow plate' effects, PCA outliers); animal↔FASTQ table; 2D and 3D PCA figures.
issues: The bundled GO annotation zips are labelled for Affymetrix GPL1355 (carried over from the microarray-era packages) and contain no S1500 probe IDs — not the annotation used for this TempO-Seq analysis.
The shared project contains the other three chemicals; a consumer must filter to this study's experiments.

facts: 1,1,2,2-Tetrahydroperfluoro-1-dodecanol (10:2 FTOH), study C04051-01, male and female Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–475 mg/kg (10 groups), liver + kidney.
Same package generation, methods and shared 16-experiment PFAS project as NIEHS-07 (see there).
issues: Same GPL1355 annotation mislabel and shared multi-chemical project as NIEHS-07.
The Animal and FASTQ Metadata zip contains a stray Word lock file (~$…docx).

facts: 2,3-Benzofluorene, study C20042-01, male and female Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–1000 mg/kg (10 groups), liver + kidney.
Same package generation, methods and shared PFAS project as NIEHS-07 (the project file is named differently here but is byte-identical).
issues: Same GPL1355 annotation mislabel and shared multi-chemical project as NIEHS-07.

facts: Perfluorohexanesulfonamide (PFHxSAm), study C20022-01, male and female Sprague Dawley rats, gavage, 0–111 mg/kg (8 groups), liver + kidney. THE reference report for this project.

Same package generation, methods and shared PFAS project as NIEHS-07. PFHxSAm expression: 2,654 probes × 44–45 animals; the Appendix C PCA figures reproduce exactly from these files (mean-centred PCA).
Individual animal data workbooks are byte-identical to the ones originally supplied to this project.
issues: Same GPL1355 annotation mislabel and shared multi-chemical project as NIEHS-07.

facts: 1,2-Dichlorobenzene (1,2-DCB), studies 108020006 (rats) / 108020007 (mice): female Sprague Dawley rats (0–500 ppm, 7 groups) and B6D2F1/Crl mice (0–250 ppm, 6 groups), whole-body INHALATION; five tissues (heart, kidney, liver, lung, ovary). DTT study numbering; a 15-page Materials and Methods PDF is in the package.

Genomics (BMDExpress 3.20.0119, 2025-04/05; documented in Materials_and_Methods.pdf): attenuation-adjusted read counts → RPM → log2; probes with a zero count in ANY sample removed ('No0': rat 1,864–2,072 probes kept); Williams p<0.05 (10,000 perm, no fold filter) → curve-fit prefilter (Hill/Power/Linear/Exp3/Exp5, BMR 2 SD) → ToxicR Laplace model averaging (Hill, Power, Exp3, Exp5), BMR 25% relative deviation, step-function threshold 0.5 → GO BP + gene categories (R²≥0.6, BMD/BMDL≤10, gene sets 40–500).

Apical BMDs move into BMDExpress (non-genomic .bm2 per species, 3.20.0119/0129): endpoints pre-screened for a significant trend plus a significant pairwise effect, then ToxicR Laplace model averaging, BMR 1 SD, 'generic' platform, defined-category file of 5-day endpoints. No BMDS workbook.

New artefacts: attenuation-adjusted raw read counts, TempO-Seq S1500 v1.2 rat and mouse manifests, per-tissue One-way ANOVA / Curve Fit / BMD exports, eFDR synthetic-null analyses (20 null data sets per tissue per species, as .bm2), transcriptomics QC reports, animal-removal workbooks, theoretical inhaled dose. Report tables are PDFs (Top 10 genes/GO per tissue, most potent GO per tissue).

'Analysis Pipeline Evaluation' (identical in NIEHS-12 and -13; updated February 2026): compares the proposed DTT tBMD method with the US EPA ETAP method across 20 five-day gavage studies (54 chemical×replicate×tissue data sets incl. BPAF, triclosan, PFOA, furan, BDCA, TBBPA). DTT method (BMDExpress 3.20.0141, Dec 2025): No0 → Williams p<0.05 (the 1.25 fold filter removed in the Feb 2026 update) → curve-fit prefilter at **1.581 SD** → ToxicR MA, BMR 25% RD → gene + GO BP; GO BP BMD = 5th-percentile gene BMD; tBMD = lowest GO BP across liver and kidney. EPA method (BMDExpress 2.30.0516): Williams + fold 1.5 → 8 models, BMR 1.349 SD, nested chi-square then lowest AIC → GO BP. Conclusion: the DTT method performs slightly better and replicates better.
issues: The rat genomic project's top-level curve-fit prefilter list holds the MOUSE results (mouse_2D_*); the rat BMD results reference their own embedded rat prefilters.
Mouse genomic experiments are not named '_No0' even though the methods describe the same zero-count filter.

facts: 1,4-Dichlorobenzene (1,4-DCB), studies 108020004 (rats) / 108020005 (mice): female Sprague Dawley rats (0–800 ppm, 7 groups) and B6D2F1/Crl mice (0–400 ppm, 6 groups), whole-body inhalation; heart, kidney, liver, lung, ovary. Companion to NIEHS-12 with the same layout and methods (Materials and Methods documents curve-fit BMR 2 SD; BMDExpress 3.20.0119).

Same artefact set as NIEHS-12: per-species genomic and non-genomic .bm2 (+ JSON), raw counts, manifests, eFDR synthetic null, QC reports, removal workbooks, study tables, PDF report tables. The Analysis Pipeline Evaluation zips are byte-identical to NIEHS-12's.
issues: The rat raw-read-count archive is published as 'Attenuation-adjusted_Raw_Read_Counts_Rat_Study,zip' (comma, no extension).
